profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
With over nine years of experience in software engineering, I bring innovative solutions to complex challenges. My diverse background spans multiple projects, ranging from scalable cloud architectures to microservices, UI/UX to AI/ML. Whether leading a team or deep diving into code, I thrive on solving problems and creating impactful solutions that drive business success.

• Expertise in designing, deploying, and managing cloud-based solutions across AWS, Azure, and open source IaaS/PaaS.
• Proven track record in leading cross-functional teams, mentoring developers, and steering projects from concept to deployment.
• Strong adaptability and quick learning - able to grasp new technologies and frameworks quickly and integrate them into effective solutions.

Passionate About Learning & Growth:
Technology doesn’t stand still, and neither do I. I actively seek out new tools, frameworks, and methodologies to stay ahead of industry trends. Whether it’s through research, classes, or hands-on experimentation, I am always expanding my skill set to provide the best solutions possible.

Volunteer & Community Involvement:
Outside of work, I’m passionate about giving back to the community. I volunteer with local animal shelters, helping with everything from fostering to adoption events. I am also passionate about STEM education, mentoring and supporting students and junior engineers.

Let’s Connect:
I’m always open to new opportunities, collaborations, and discussions. Feel free to reach out if you’d like to connect!
